text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Gold Ship's grand battle with Eishin Flash in the Arima Kinen has arrived…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna land a big one today! Let's do this thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's even more pumped than usual and absolutely ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You know my dad was a fisherman, right? Well, he told me something one day.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: He said: "Rough waters are inevitable in life, but you've got an angler's spirit strong enough to ride them out."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I bet Flash is trying to land a big one, just like I am…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But I'll never let her take over the line where the Kuroshio Current and Oyashio Current meet! I stake my old man's name on it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go out there and catch a hundred squids! No, scratch that—a thousand! Squids for aaaall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's so powered up that she leaves before I can even wish her good luck.
